action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that Yodl incorrectly handled certain input, leading to a
buffer over-read. An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause Yodl
to crash, resulting in a denial of service.
isummary: Yodl could be made to crash if it opened a specially crafted file.
title: Yodl vulnerability
